That all affidavits, which have been previously made
and read in Court upon any proceeding ina cause or mat-
ter, may be used before the Master.
That, where upon an enquiry before the Master affida-
vits are received, then no affidavit in reply shall be read
except as to new matter which may be stated in the
affidavits in answer, nor shall any further affidavits be read
unless specially required by the Master.
That, in cases where estates or other property are
directed to be sold before the Master, the Master shall
be at liberty, if he shall think it for the benefit of the-
ties interested, to order the same to be sold in the coun-
try at such place and by such person as he shall think fit.
